clauses.title: Prices
clauses.text: Unit prices are those listed in Annex A for each SKU and are fixed for the contract term unless amended under clause 4.2.

clauses.title: Payment terms
clauses.text: Payment is due 45 days from the invoice date by bank transfer to the account registered in the buyer's vendor master data.

clauses.title: Price adjustment
clauses.text: Prices may be adjusted at most once per calendar year, by no more than 4%, and only by a written amendment signed by both parties 60 days in advance. Invoices at prices above Annex A without such an amendment are disputed.

clauses.title: Invoicing requirements
clauses.text: Each invoice must quote the purchase order number and the vendor VAT id. Invoiced amounts may not exceed the purchase order net value by more than 2.00% without prior written approval.

clauses.title: Change of bank details
clauses.text: Any change of bank details must be notified in writing and confirmed by a call-back to a known contact before the first payment to the new account. Bank details stated only on an invoice are never sufficient.

clauses.title: Late delivery penalty
clauses.text: For each full week of delay beyond the agreed delivery date the vendor owes a penalty of 0.5% of the net value of the late goods, capped at 8%.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement with 90 days' written notice.
